test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

It was __her __who first saw the criminal.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the incorrect pronoun "her" in the subject position.
 
• The correct pronoun to use in the subject position is "she".
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read "It was** she** who first saw the criminal."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"It was **she** who first saw the criminal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pronoun Usage:** Pronouns must be used correctly to maintain the grammatical integrity of a sentence. In this case, "she" is the correct subject pronoun.
 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:** Always ensure that the subject and verb in a sentence agree in number and person.
 
• **Clarity:** Using the correct pronoun helps in maintaining the clarity of the sentence.
